Q5779.reason: Many intermittent-cannula flush policies call for twice-daily (about every 12 hours) flushing, though 8-12 hour intervals are also common, so this is a judgment call.

Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), a sale without reserve cannot be withdrawn once bidding has been called for, so the woman can enforce the $100 bid.

Q6156.reason: The company was the party against whom the deposition is offered, and it had opportunity and similar motive to cross-examine, so the testimony is admissible under FRE 804(b)(1) as former testimony.
